versions.subject: rule: Winrar comprress .dmp file
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: 
        - '\rar.exe'
        - '\winrar.exe'
    - Description: 'Command line RAR'
dumpfile:
    CommandLine: '.dmp'
condition: selection and dumpfile
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\rar.exe", "*\\winrar.exe") OR Description="Command line RAR" CommandLine=".dmp"
